capabilities.name: Validate a skill
capabilities.description: Pass `path` to `skillcheck` for a full structural check against the agentskills.io specification. Validates name constraints, description quality, body sizing, file references, and cross-agent compatibility. The `validation report` is written to stdout. Exit codes: 0 no errors, 1 errors found, 2 input error (missing file), 3 symbolic passed but semantic critique flagged errors.

capabilities.name: Review a skill with an agent
capabilities.description: skillcheck generates a structured critique prompt for `path` and ingests `response.json` as the agent's reply. Save the emitted prompt to `prompt.txt`. The merged `validation report` combines symbolic diagnostics and semantic findings from the critique.

capabilities.name: Extract a capability graph
capabilities.description: skillcheck extracts the `capability graph` from heading structure and backtick references in the body of `path`. Use `prompt.txt` for emitted graph prompts and ingest `response.json` from your agent for richer extraction.

capabilities.name: Check validation history
capabilities.description: Append a record to the `validation ledger` for each `--history` run on `path`. The ledger is stored in `.skillcheck-history.json` next to the skill file, is append-only, and is safe to commit.
